i1: What does Jesus want everybody to become?
i2: Which is the more popular term — "Disciple" or "Christian?" The word "Christian" only appears 3 times in the New Testament. It is the name those in the world gave the disciples, seven years after the church began. (Acts 11:19-26) The word "Disciple" occurs over 270 times in the New Testament.
i4: Jesus came to make disciples. Only baptized disciples will be saved.
jesusDefines: Jesus defines disciple, thus defining who is a true Christian.
o1a: This was the calling of the first disciples.
o1c: "Fishers of men" — Jesus gave these first disciples the real purpose for living.
o2a: "If any man" means everyone… and anyone (v. 23).
o2b: "Deny self" is to be like Christ in the Garden recorded in Matthew 26:36-39, "Not my will, but your will." Do not give into moods, emotions, etc.
o2c: "Carry the cross daily." Die to ourselves every day (v. 23).
o2d: Either gain world and forfeit your soul or lose your life for Jesus and save it (v. 25).
o3a: "If any man" means everyone… and anyone (v. 26).
o3d: Love Christ more than any person (v. 26)
o4a: Must learn to pray. The disciples saw the strength Jesus received from the Father.
o4b: A daily personal relationship with God will have daily prayers (v. 3).
o5b: Be an active part of the fellowship.
o6a: The command — "make disciples" — is given to all.
o6b: Who is a candidate for baptism? People who make the decision to be a disciple.
o6c: You need someone to disciple you to maturity in Christ.
o6d: This is the only way to save the world!
conclusionQuestions: Conclusion Questions: Am I a disciple? Am I a Christian? Am I saved? What do I need to do to become a disciple?
